info.title: Infrawrench API
info.description: REST API for the Infrawrench cloud SaaS. Plugin and resource type IDs are enumerated from the live plugin registry at spec-build time, so this document always matches what the running server actually accepts.

sessionCookie.name: wos-session
sessionCookie.description: WorkOS-issued sealed session cookie (httpOnly, set by `/callback`). Used by browser clients.

bearerAuth.description: WorkOS access token (JWT) or Infrawrench API key. Used by programmatic clients.

qrCode.description: Data-URI image of the enrolment QR code

current.description: True for the session making this request

bastionId.description: Bastion this account's cloud-API egress is routed through. `null` ⇒ direct egress.

PluginId.description: Manifest id of an installed plugin.

bastionId.description: Optional bastion id to route this account's cloud API traffic through.
Pass `null` to unbind, a uuid to bind, or omit the field to leave the binding unchanged.

JsonObject.description: Free-form JSON object whose shape depends on the plugin.

ResourceTypeId.description: Resource type id. Note: not every plugin exposes every type — see the plugin's `resourceTypes` for the valid (pluginId, typeId) pairs.

date.description: UTC day the spend belongs to.

amount.description: Money for this day/dimension combination. Negative for credits.

resourceId.description: Opaque id of the thing being billed; groups the `resource` dimension.

tags.description: Cost-allocation tags, at most 32. Keys starting with `infrawrench:` are reserved and rejected.

accountId.description: Attribute this row to a connected account. Must belong to the calling organization. Omit to attribute it to the source itself.

source.description: Stable slug naming the system that owns these rows: letters, digits, `.`, `_` and `-`. It groups the rows under an `External` provider and an `external:<source>` account, and re-pushing the same source over the same days restates only its own rows.

costPollError.description: Last cost-collection failure for this account, cleared on the next success. `helpLink` points at the provider page that fixes a setup problem when the plugin can identify one (e.g. GCP's billing export console).

delivered.description: True when at least one recipient was reached on any transport.

suppressed.description: True when the key was still in cooldown, so nothing was sent.

sms.description: Twilio deliveries (SMS + voice) that Twilio accepted.

msTeams.description: Microsoft Teams webhook posts Teams accepted.

retryAt.description: When suppressed, the time at which this key can page again.

source.description: Stable name for the system raising the page: letters, digits, `.`, `_` and `-`. It is the notification's sender, and it scopes the cooldown — two services paging under the same key never throttle each other.

message.description: The alert text. Becomes the SMS and notification body.

title.description: Short headline for the notification. Defaults to `source`.

key.description: Throttle key, `default` when unset. Pages sharing a key are suppressed while that key is in cooldown, so a per-object key (a host, a cluster id) alerts per object while the default key alerts once for the whole source.

cooldownMinutes.description: Minutes to suppress repeat pages under the same key. Defaults to 60; `0` sends every time.

voice.description: Also place a voice call to recipients who opted into voice. Off by default — reserve it for things worth waking someone up for.

cleared.description: False when the key had no cooldown to clear.

ResourceStatus.description: Normalized status reported by a plugin's renderSidebarItem/renderDetail.

privateKey.description: Returned once. Not persisted in plaintext.

token.description: Enrollment token in the form `iwb_<random>`. Pass to the agent container as `BASTION_TOKEN`. Returned once — not recoverable later.

Permission.description: A permission string. Roles may grant exact permissions like the entries in this enum, or wildcards (e.g. `resources:*:read`, `*`).

complimentary.description: Platform-granted complimentary access: all paid perks, uncapped AI chat, never billed.

legacyHashSunsetAt.description: Cutover date past which a key still on the legacy SHA-256 hash will be refused. Null once rehashed to HMAC.

needsRotation.description: True when this key is still hashed with the legacy SHA-256 scheme and should be rotated before `legacyHashSunsetAt`.

hasCredentials.description: Whether the account has stored credentials. The credentials themselves are never returned here — this endpoint only requires `resources:read`. Fetch one with `GET /api/org/{orgId}/accounts/{id}/credentials`, which requires `secrets:read` and is audit-logged.

subscriptionStatus.description: Stripe subscription status, or null when the org never checked out

lastSeenAt.description: ISO timestamp of the last registration

disabled.description: True when delivery failures disabled the device

workflowPages.description: Alerts raised by a workflow calling infra.page(...)

id.description: Infrawrench id for this workspace connection

workflowPages.description: Alerts raised by a workflow calling infra.page(...)

configured.description: True when this deployment has a Slack app registered

label.description: Display name for the channel, e.g. #alerts

urlHint.description: Non-secret hint at the stored webhook URL (host and last four characters). The URL itself is never returned.

workflowPages.description: Alerts raised by a workflow calling infra.page(...)

url.description: The webhook URL from a Teams 'Workflows' automation. Must be https and on a Microsoft-operated host (*.api.powerautomate.com, *.api.powerplatform.com, *.logic.azure.com, *.flow.microsoft.com, or a legacy *.webhook.office.com connector).

post.summary: Push cost rows from your own systems
post.description:
Reports spend Infrawrench has no provider plugin for — a parsed SaaS invoice, an internal chargeback, a colo bill — into the same store the provider collectors write to, so it appears in cost graphs, dimension filters, and budgets alongside everything else.

Rows are grouped under a caller-chosen `source`. Writes are idempotent per `(source, day, service, region, resourceId, tags, currency)`: pushing the same day again restates that day rather than adding to it, so a nightly job can safely re-push a trailing window. Rows pushed under a source can never overwrite rows a provider collector wrote.

The whole batch is validated before anything is stored, so a 400 means nothing was written.

_Requires permission: `costs:write`._

post.summary: Query aggregated cost series
post.description:
Aggregates collected provider spend into per-bucket, per-group series for cost graphs. Currencies are never merged; mixed-currency orgs get one series per currency. Optionally returns a previous-period comparison and a trend forecast.

_Requires permission: `costs:read`._

get.description:

post.summary: Raise an alert to the organization's on-call transports
post.description:
Fans an alert out over whatever the org has configured — Twilio SMS (and voice on request), mobile push, Slack channels, and Microsoft Teams webhooks — honouring each recipient's opt-ins. This is the same alert a workflow raises with `infra.page(...)`, for code that runs somewhere Infrawrench does not: a health check, a deploy script, a cron on a box.

Repeat pages under the same `(source, key)` are **suppressed, not rejected**: a monitor that fires every minute pages once and then gets `200` with `suppressed: true` and the `retryAt` at which the key can page again. A page that reached nobody does not start a cooldown, so the next call tries again.

Recipients opt in per channel under the same setting that covers workflow pages.

_Requires permission: `pages:write`._

delete.description:
Drops the cooldown for one `(source, key)` so the next page under it delivers immediately. Call it when the condition you alerted on recovers — the workflow equivalent is `infra.page.clear(key)`. Clearing a key that was never paged is not an error.

_Requires permission: `pages:write`._

schema.description: Stable name for the system raising the page: letters, digits, `.`, `_` and `-`. It is the notification's sender, and it scopes the cooldown — two services paging under the same key never throttle each other.

get.summary: Full resource detail page payload
get.description:
Performs a live `listResources` against the provider, falls back to DB on failure, and returns the plugin's `renderDetail` schema plus host-derived flags (SQL/KV/SSH availability, child resources, peer panes, etc).

_Requires permission: `resources:read`._

schema.description: Default true. If false, peer panes are returned as stubs.
